prompt: A three-seat mid-century sofa in emerald velvet: rounded track arms, three seat cushions and three back cushions with soft bulging shapes, channel tufting on the back, tapered brass-tipped legs, and two contrasting throw pillows.

A generic unbranded kitchen stand mixer in glossy red: tilt-head design with a motor head that tilts back on click, a polished steel bowl on a base plate, a flat beater attachment that spins in a planetary motion, a speed lever, and rubber feet.

A 1940s tabletop tube radio: rounded-top walnut cabinet, a fabric speaker grille with vertical brass bars, a glowing amber tuning dial with a moving needle, and two knobs. Turning the right knob (drag) moves the needle.

A hot air balloon with a teardrop envelope in alternating colored vertical gores, suspension ropes, a burner that flares with a flame light periodically, and a wicker basket. The balloon drifts slowly upward and sways above rolling green hills.

An octagonal white wooden garden gazebo: eight posts with decorative corner brackets, lattice railings, a pointed shingled roof with a finial, a few steps up to the floor, climbing roses on two posts, and a bench inside. Set on a small lawn with a stone path.

A dense bamboo grove: dozens of tall segmented bamboo culms with visible nodes in varied greens, narrow leaf clusters at the tops, a mossy ground with fallen leaves, and a narrow stone path through the middle. Culms sway slightly in a breeze.

A modern three-blade wind turbine on a tapered white tower: a nacelle housing, a hub with three long aerodynamic blades that rotate, and a small cutaway view (toggle) showing the gearbox and generator inside the nacelle. Stands on a grassy hill.

An open bamboo steamer basket with eight pleated soup dumplings on a lettuce leaf liner, steam wisps rising, the bamboo lid leaning against it, a small dish of black vinegar with ginger slivers, a porcelain spoon, and chopsticks.

A museum gallery hall about 20 m x 12 m: white walls with evenly spaced framed paintings (plain color abstract rectangles only), two freestanding sculptures on pedestals, a bench in the center, track lighting, a doorway to the next room, and a wall-mounted room-number and directional sign. Camera at 1.6 m eye height.

An original hedgehog gardener character (not based on any existing IP): round body with soft spines, a straw hat, a tiny green apron, holding a small watering can, standing beside a flower pot. It waters the flower in a looping animation and the flower grows slightly.
